purpose: Teach: ボーダフォン/サラ金/マーチ/ワーム/ヒューザー/プッシュ/エクスプレス/光ファイバー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、旧ボーダフォン時代の契約資料を整理しろ
lines.en: I want you to organize the old Vodafone-era contract documents for the company.
lines.style: Steady directive. Clipped, efficient phrasing. No room for pushback. Expects immediate acknowledgment and action. Eyes on the line, not the person.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員にサラ金、つまり消費者金融を借りない様注意喚起します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the staff know not to take out consumer loans.
lines.style: Formal, attentive response. Speaks clearly and methodically. Confirms understanding without elaboration. Shows he's tracking the instruction precisely.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、日産マーチ等の小型車を社用車にしろ
lines.en: Have the company switch its fleet vehicles to small cars like the Nissan March.
lines.style: Measured command. Matter-of-fact tone. Specifies the example with the same authority as the order. Pauses slightly after 'March' to let it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サーバのワーム感染対策を強化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also strengthen our server security against worm infections.
lines.style: Composed acknowledgment. Takes the instruction as a given and adds a related action. Speaks with quiet confidence about the technical step. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、旧ヒューザーの教訓を社員研修で扱え
lines.en: Make sure the company addresses the Huizer lessons in employee training.
lines.style: Direct order with an undertone of seriousness. Slower pace on 'Huizer lessons'—it carries weight. Expects this to be treated as important institutional memory.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。販促のプッシュ通知を最適化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also optimize our promotional push notifications.
lines.style: Quick, assured response. Clips the ends of words slightly. Shows he's already thinking ahead, layering in another improvement. Professional confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、エクスプレス配送サービスを拡充しろ
lines.en: Expand the company's express delivery service.
lines.style: Final directive. Slightly quicker tempo. Commands with finality. Sets the closure of the instruction sequence. Expects completion as standard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内ネットワークを光ファイバーに切り替えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll have the internal network switched over to fiber optic.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Measured, professional. States the action as a completed intention, not a question. Respectful finality. Slight nod in the tone.
